text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Western European Police's (WEU) mandate in the southwest city of Mostar expires on October 14. WEU responsibilities will be gradually transferred to joint federal police forces of the Neretva canton.

- The U.S. government's bureau for refugees and migration says Gorazde, in eastern Bosnia, will be "a priority area" for refugee assistance. U.S. diplomat says the bureau will be fully committed "to get Gorazde back on its feet".
- The Bosnian bureau for statistics says the number of unemployed in Bosnia is now 650,000.
- The first post-war commercial bus from Belgrade to Sarajevo is due to arrive in Sarajevo October 14. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
